rca_of_the_issue: Task comment user_name bug: The JWT token created in /app/backend/api/auth.py (lines 96-102) only includes user_id, email, company_id, and role - it does NOT include full_name. When tasks.py line 390 calls user_data.get('full_name', 'Unknown'), it returns 'Unknown' because full_name is not in the token payload. Fix: Either add full_name to JWT payload OR fetch user from database using user_id.
